companyProfile.sectorNote: Bobot metode disesuaikan dengan karakter sektor dan kualitas data.

methods.name: Historical P/E 3Y
methods.warning: HIGH MULTIPLE · P/E >60x diterima karena konsisten dengan distribusi historis emiten; confidence diturunkan.
methods.explanation: EPS TTM tervalidasi (Yahoo TTM cross-check) × median P/E historis 3 tahun. Outlier dinilai relatif terhadap histori emiten.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 4.16x dari median metode.

methods.name: Historical P/E 5Y
methods.warning: HIGH MULTIPLE · P/E >60x diterima karena konsisten dengan distribusi historis emiten; confidence diturunkan.
methods.explanation: EPS TTM tervalidasi (Yahoo TTM cross-check) × median P/E historis 5 tahun. Outlier dinilai relatif terhadap histori emiten.

methods.name: Graham Number
methods.warning: Cross-check konservatif; tidak dihitung sebagai keluarga independen.
methods.explanation: Cross-check konservatif berbasis EPS dan BVPS tervalidasi.

methods.name: Forward Earnings Power
methods.explanation: Forward EPS memakai normalized sustainable growth dan adaptive historical P/E.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 3.70x dari median metode.

methods.name: Justified PBV / ROE
methods.explanation: PBV wajar diturunkan dari ROE, normalized growth dan cost of equity.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 5.58x dari median metode.

methods.name: Earnings Power Value
methods.explanation: No-growth earnings power: EPS tervalidasi dikapitalisasi dengan required return. Growth tidak dipakai sebagai pengerek nilai.
methods.qcReason: Ditolak cross-method outlier: deviasi 5.64x dari median metode.

guards: P/E tidak lolos sanity check atau EPS tidak tervalidasi; Historical P/E dinonaktifkan.
Tidak ada metode core yang lolos QC; ticker tetap diterbitkan agar fallback model dapat dicoba.
Historical P/E 3Y adaptive: median 223.1x, current 92.1x; confidence diturunkan.
Historical P/E 5Y adaptive: median 178.5x, current 92.1x; confidence diturunkan.
Composite FV tidak diterbitkan: minimal 2 keluarga valuasi independen wajib lolos QC.
FV Indikatif diterbitkan karena >=2 metode valid tersedia tetapi bukti keluarga independen belum cukup untuk Composite FV penuh.

quarterlyNormalization.method: same-quarter YoY -> median/MAD outlier removal -> recency weighting -> earnings + operating/cash confirmation
notes: Sign changes and near-zero denominators are excluded from percentage growth and treated as turnaround/base-effect conditions.
Extreme reported growth remains visible in observations but is not allowed to dominate sustainable growth.

valuationPolicy.growthSource: Robust quarterly sustainable growth when available; legacy normalized growth otherwise.
valuationPolicy.principle: Sector-aware evidence weighting; market price is QC guard only, never valuation target.
valuationPolicy.marketAnchorPolicy: Market price is not a valuation target. Distance to market is reviewed only after fundamental model construction.
valuationPolicy.consensus: One consensus vote per independent family; cross-family disagreement is preserved as uncertainty.

valuationReview.policy: Indicative FV is method-derived; market price is not a valuation anchor.
